---
title: 'funga_mycobank_gap'
description: 'Find fungal species in MycoBank that are potentially Brazilian but missing from FFB'
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---


```{r}
#| eval: false
fungaR::funga_mycobank_gap()
```

### Description

Given a fungal genus or order, cross-checks [MycoBank](https://www.mycobank.org)'s
global nomenclatural database against the Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB) checklist to
flag species-level names that exist in MycoBank but are not currently registered in
FFB. When `check_occurrence = TRUE` (default), each candidate name is further
cross-checked against [GBIF](https://www.gbif.org) (and, best-effort,
[speciesLink](https://specieslink.net)) for occurrence evidence from Brazil, so
that taxonomic experts reviewing the output spreadsheet can prioritize candidates that
already have independent evidence of occurring in the country.

### Details

MycoBank does not offer a public search API suited to bulk automation, but it does
publish a full, regularly-updated bulk export of every name in its database
(https://www.mycobank.org/images/MBList.zip). This function downloads and caches
that export locally (the same way `funga_download` caches the FFB dataset),
then filters it down to the requested genus or order using MycoBank's own
`Classification` column, rather than attempting to scrape MycoBank's live,
JavaScript-driven search interface.

The FFB side of the comparison reuses `funga_get_children_taxa` to list every
species (accepted and synonym) currently registered in FFB for the requested genus/order.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| taxon | Character. A single fungal genus or order name (e.g. `"Trichoderma"` or `"Xylariales"`). |
| rank | Character. Whether `taxon` is a `"genus"` (default) or an `"order"`. |
| check_occurrence | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), each MycoBank name missing from FFB is additionally queried against GBIF (and speciesLink, best-effort) for Brazil-only occurrence records, adding evidence columns to help prioritize which candidates are worth a taxonomist's manual review. Set to `FALSE` to skip this (much faster, but without occurrence evidence). |
| max_check | Numeric. Safety cap on how many missing candidates are sent through the (comparatively slow, one-request-per-name) occurrence check when `check_occurrence = TRUE`. Defaults to `200`; if more candidates are found, only the first `max_check` (alphabetically) are checked and a warning is issued. Ignored when `check_occurrence = FALSE`. |
| version | Character. FFB dataset version to compare against. Defaults to `"latest"`. Passed to `funga_get_children_taxa`. |
| mycobank_dir | Character. Local directory used to cache the downloaded MycoBank bulk export. Defaults to `"mycobank_download"`. Reused on subsequent calls to avoid re-downloading the (~140MB) file. |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints progress messages. |
| save | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the result is saved to disk as an `.xlsx` spreadsheet. |
| dir | Character. Directory where the spreadsheet is saved when `save = TRUE`. Defaults to `"funga_mycobank_gap"`. |
| filename | Character. Name of the `.xlsx` file (without extension) to save. Defaults to `"funga_mycobank_gap_<taxon>"`. |

### Value

A `data.frame`, one row per MycoBank species-level name found in the
  requested genus/order that is absent from the current FFB checklist, with columns:

  MycoBank_NumberMycoBank's numeric identifier for the name.
  Taxon_nameThe binomial as registered in MycoBank.
  AuthorsFull author citation.
  Name_statusMycoBank's nomenclatural status (e.g. `"Legitimate"`).
  ClassificationFull MycoBank classification string (Kingdom to genus).
  Current_nameMycoBank's currently accepted name for this entry, when different
    (i.e. when `Taxon_name` is itself a synonym).
  MycoBank_URLDirect link to the name's MycoBank page.
  GBIF_Brazil_records, GBIF_Brazil_statesOccurrence count and states with GBIF
    records from Brazil (only when `check_occurrence = TRUE`).
  speciesLink_Brazil_records, speciesLink_Brazil_statesSame, from speciesLink,
    best-effort (see Note).
  In_FFBAlways `FALSE` (kept for clarity when combining with other tables).

### Examples

```r
# Species-level names in MycoBank for genus Trichoderma missing from FFB,
# with Brazil-occurrence evidence from GBIF/speciesLink
gap <- funga_mycobank_gap(taxon = "Trichoderma", rank = "genus")

# Faster, without the occurrence cross-check
gap_fast <- funga_mycobank_gap(taxon = "Trichoderma", rank = "genus",
                               check_occurrence = FALSE)
```
